source: Where... am I?
target: 我……在哪儿？

source: What just happened?
target: 刚才发生了什么？

source: Ophelia!
target: 奥菲莉娅！

source: You've arrived!
target: 你来了！

source: What's... everyone... doing here?
target: 大家……都在这里……做什么？

source: Um, you mean you don't know? The show's nearly over!
target: 呃，你是说你不知道？戏都快结束了！

source: We're here for the final act, of sorts.
target: 我们是为最后一幕来的，算是吧。

source: We all came here to see what you'd do next.
target: 我们都来看看，你接下来会做什么。

source: After you've left this world, that is.
target: 我是说，在你离开这个世界之后。

source: And of course, to offer our sincere and heartfelt advice on these matters.
target: 当然，我们也会就这些事给出真诚、发自内心的建议。

source: Not that we have the final say in anything.
target: 不过，任何事都不是我们说了算。

source: Indeed. It's all up to you, love.
target: 没错。全由你决定，亲爱的。

source: Consider this a temporary space to explore what has been and might be.
target: 把这里当作一个暂时的空间，探索已经发生的事，以及可能发生的事。

source: ...So this is...
target: ……所以这里是……

source: ...This is some kind of... curtain call?
target: ……这算是某种……谢幕？

source: And if I leave here... then... all of this... will be over?
target: 如果我离开这里……那……这一切……就会结束？

source: Time will move forward—and this will—be my fate?
target: 时间会继续向前——而这就会——成为我的命运？

source: Yes, that would seem to make good sense.
target: 是的，这样说倒是很有道理。

source: ...Or, Option B, you could just stop thinking about it so hard.
target: ……或者，还有第二种选择，你可以别再这么费劲地琢磨了。

source: I hate those people at the theater. Always scrutinizing everything to death.
target: 我讨厌剧院里的那些人。什么都要翻来覆去地分析个没完。

source: We're all here to see you off. Even the dead are here. Isn't that enough?
target: 我们都是来给你送行的。连死去的人都来了。这还不够吗？

source: The dead?
target: 死去的人？

source: Indeed. For a small while, the Book of Fates can make even this miracle possible.
target: 确实。命运之书能让这样的奇迹也成为可能，哪怕只有片刻。

source: Indeed. For a small while, the Book of Fates can make even this miracle possible.
target: 没错。命运之书甚至能让这样的奇迹短暂地成为现实。

source: I see.
target: 我明白了。

source: Then I won't waste this chance, everyone.
target: 那我不会浪费这个机会的，各位。

source: I'm going to make the best decision I can.
target: 我会尽我所能，做出最好的决定。

source: Hooraaaay!
target: 好耶——！

source: Marvelous. Let's get to it.
target: 太好了。我们开始吧。

source: Aah, she's here, she's here!
target: 啊，她来了，她来了！

source: Places, everyone! Please! It's time for the final curtain call!
target: 各位，请就位！拜托了！最后的谢幕要开始了！

source: If you'll allow me, I shall set the scene.
target: 容我先交代一下眼下的情形。

source: What say you about this, friends?
target: 朋友们，你们对此有什么看法？

source: I'm opposed, of course.

source: As am I. Ophelia, how could you even think of leaving us like that?
target: 我也反对。奥菲莉娅，你怎么连这样离开我们的念头都能有？

source: I love you. I want you to live on. I can't imagine a complete life without you.
target: 我爱你。我希望你继续活下去。我无法想象，没有你的人生还能完整。

source: Oh, you can't imagine life without her? You, who would leave her to gallivant around Paris?
target: 哦，你无法想象没有她的生活？你可是会丢下她，跑去巴黎寻欢作乐的人啊？

source: Forty thousand brothers could not, with all their quantity of love, make up my sum—
target: 四万个兄弟的爱加在一起，也抵不过我的爱——

source: Stop that, lads. Stop bickering. Need everything be a competition with you two?
target: 够了，小伙子们。别吵了。你们两个非得什么事都争个高下吗？

source: ...Ophelia, dear heart, you already know my thoughts.
target: ……奥菲莉娅，心爱的孩子，你已经知道我的想法了。

source: To think of losing you the way I lost your mother—it would crush me.
target: 想到我会像失去你母亲那样失去你——我会崩溃的。

source: I'm certain I couldn't survive it.
target: 我知道自己一定撑不下去。

source: You are one of the few good things in our life. In all of our lives.
target: 你是我们生命中为数不多的美好之一。对我们每个人来说，都是如此。

source: Things might seem dark now. But isn't there another way, my love? Surely there must be.
target: 现在也许看不到希望。可是，亲爱的，就没有别的办法了吗？一定还有的。

source: You're wrong.
target: 你错了。

source: I understand why you're saying this, Polonius. But you're wrong.
target: 我理解你为什么这么说，波洛涅斯。但你错了。

source: You know exactly what you're doing, don't you, Ophelia?
target: 你很清楚自己在做什么，对吧，奥菲莉娅？

source: If you were to die...
target: 如果你死了……

source: Then one by one, the next pieces fall. Your brother gets his revenge. The Danish throne begins to implode. Hamlet dies.
target: 接下来，局面就会一步步崩塌。你的哥哥会报仇。丹麦王室会开始从内部瓦解。哈姆雷特会死。

source: Everything goes to ruin.
target: 一切都会毁灭。

source: But the way things are now, in this country—it's festering from the inside. You see a side of it we don't.
target: 可是，看看这个国家如今的情形——它正在从内部腐烂。你看到了我们看不到的一面。

source: If you die, then that allows something new to be born. That's why I was sent to kill you once.
target: 如果你死了，就能让新的事物诞生。所以我曾经奉命去杀你。

source: To be frank, that's a future we should all be grateful for.
target: 坦白说，那是我们所有人都该心怀感激的未来。

source: But what is a future like that worth if Ophelia must suffer for it?
target: 可如果奥菲莉娅必须为此受苦，这样的未来又有什么价值？

source: She has done nothing wrong. She is innocent.
target: 她什么都没做错。她是无辜的。

source: It doesn't matter. She's the only one who can die to create this fate.
target: 那不重要。只有她的死，才能造就这样的命运。

source: My husband and I will suffer, too. This is a death sentence for us, Ophelia.
target: 我和我丈夫也会受苦。奥菲莉娅，这等于判了我们死刑。

source: It's true we... weren't always good. Both of us did things we aren't proud of.
target: 我们确实……不是一直都做得对。我们两个都做过让自己感到羞愧的事。

source: But if what Brit's saying is true, is it right that you condemn us to death for it?
target: 可如果布莉特说的是真的，你就该因此判我们死刑吗？

source: You have the choice to save us. I don't want to die! I want to live and find a way to be good!
target: 你可以选择救我们。我不想死！我想活下去，找到办法做个好人！

source: My wife speaks the truth. Choosing this ending leaves me with no path to redeem myself.
target: 我妻子说得对。选择这个结局，我就再也没有机会赎罪了。

source: Nor Hamlet.
target: 哈姆雷特也一样。

source: Yes. Although death is what I wished for, once—in my heart I've always been uncertain.
target: 是的。虽然我曾经渴望死亡——可我心里一直没有拿定主意。

source: Yes. Although death is what I wished for, once--in my heart I've always been uncertain.
target: 是的。虽然我曾经渴望死亡——但在心里，我始终拿不定主意。

source: What if I was meant to live? What if there are greater things I could do for this world than to die?
target: 如果我本该活下去呢？如果比起死去，我还能为这个世界做些更有意义的事呢？

source: If you choose this fate, I'll never get to find out.
target: 如果你选择这个命运，我就永远没机会知道了。

source: This was the fate I brought upon myself by virtue of my inaction, once.
target: 曾经，我的无所作为为自己招来了这样的命运。

source: This was the fate I brought upon myself by virtue of my inaction, once.
target: 我曾经因为自己的无所作为，给自己招来了这样的命运。

source: I did not know I had a choice to make at the time. I never found the Book of Fates. But in my heart of hearts, I chose it all the same.
target: 当时我不知道自己还有选择。我从未找到命运之书。但在内心最深处，我仍然选择了它。

source: If this is the future you desire, choose it with intent, Ophelia.
target: 如果这就是你想要的未来，奥菲莉娅，那就明确地选择它。

source: If this is the future you desire, choose it with intent, Ophelia.
target: 如果这就是你想要的未来，就明确地选择它，奥菲莉娅。

source: Do not shy away from the world, as I did. Go into the darkness with strength. Go with purpose.
target: 不要像我那样逃避世界。带着力量向黑暗中前行。带着目标前行。

source: That is all.
target: 我要说的就是这些。

source: That is all.
target: 我要说的就是这些。

source: Thank you, everyone.
target: 谢谢大家。

source: I think I know what I ought to know, now.
target: 我想，现在我已经知道了自己该知道的事。

source: What say you about this, friends?
target: 朋友们，你们对此有什么看法？

source: We recently announced the news to all at Elsinore.
target: 我们最近已经向埃尔西诺的所有人宣布了这个消息。

source: Once the tide of war has receded, we'll make the leap from betrothal to wedding.
target: 等战火平息，我们就会从订婚走向成婚。

source: Admittedly, there will be some pushback, but... I believe there's ample standing here to make Ophelia my wife.
target: 诚然，会有一些反对的声音，但……我相信，我有足够的依据迎娶奥菲莉娅。

source: But she... is the reason I'm dead.
target: 可是她……就是我死去的原因。

source: Were it not for you, Ophelia, I'd be with my husband.
target: 如果不是因为你，奥菲莉娅，我还会和我丈夫在一起。

source: I—I know it is the birthright of a King that he have a Queen beside him.
target: 我——我知道，国王身边有一位王后，是他与生俱来的权利。

source: I-- I know it is the birthright of a King that he have a Queen beside him.
target: 我——我知道，国王身边有一位王后，是他与生俱来的权利。

source: And my husband might have come to you himself in time, it's true.
target: 而且，假以时日，我丈夫也许会主动来找你，这倒是真的。

source: But you went to him and you ployed his affections in his moment of deepest despair, didn't you?
target: 但你去找了他，趁他最绝望的时候，耍手段利用了他的感情，不是吗？

source: You knew what you were doing.
target: 你清楚自己在做什么。

source: Yes, yes, that's certainly true! You played me like a fiddle!
target: 对，对，确实如此！你把我玩弄于股掌之间！

source: We ought to both hope that the real me never uncovers what you did!
target: 我们两个都该祈祷，真正的我永远不会发现你做过的事！

source: Yes, this was far from a healthy match. One might call it outright predatory on both ends.
target: 是啊，这段婚姻远谈不上健康。甚至可以说，双方都在肆无忌惮地掠夺对方。

source: Still, in spite of that, I think you'd make an excellent queen.
target: 不过，即便如此，我还是觉得你会成为一位出色的王后。

source: ...He's right, you know.
target: ……他说得没错。

source: I... don't think I can ever accept you marrying Claudius. I'll always be furious about that.
target: 我……觉得自己永远都无法接受你嫁给克劳狄斯。我永远都会为此愤怒。

source: He murdered my father. And you sided with him. That makes you a monster. You're no better than he is.
target: 他谋杀了我的父亲。而你站在了他那边。这样一来，你也是个恶魔。你并不比他好。

source: But even despite that, as a ruler, you have something in you that I never did.
target: 但即便如此，作为统治者，你身上有我从未拥有的东西。

source: Determination.
target: 决心。

source: You will need to be ruthlessly determined if you intend to survive the damage my father's death left behind.
target: 如果你想在我父亲的死所留下的创伤中活下来，就必须有冷酷而坚定的决心。

source: Well, I'm glad that I don't have to marry Hamlet or Claudius.
target: 嗯，我倒是很庆幸，既不用嫁给哈姆雷特，也不用嫁给克劳狄斯。

source: I was afraid my father would want to make a political match. And I came rather close.
target: 我原本怕父亲想安排一桩政治联姻。而我差一点就躲不过去了。

source: Now the two of us may be wed.
target: 现在我们两个可以结婚了。

source: I didn't think of that! Yes, hrm... yes... a delightful match, if her father is willing.
target: 我倒没想到这一点！是啊，嗯……是啊……如果她父亲愿意，那会是一桩美好的婚事。

source: Under ordinary circumstances, he wouldn't be. But with Laertes' sister as the new Queen, things have shifted.
target: 通常他是不会愿意的。但雷欧提斯的妹妹成了新王后，情况就不同了。

source: So thank you, Ophelia. Your decision might bring the two of us some happiness, at least.
target: 所以，谢谢你，奥菲莉娅。你的决定至少可能给我们两个带来一些幸福。

source: Although I never knew for certain that Claudius was his brother's killer...
target: 虽然我从未确知克劳狄斯就是杀害他哥哥的凶手……

source: I always suspected it, in my heart of hearts. I don't know that I could ever live happy, seeing my daughter at his side.
target: 但在内心最深处，我一直有所怀疑。看着女儿陪在他身边，我不知道自己还能不能过得快乐。

source: It is strange, how these matters bear forth.
target: 世事如此发展，真是奇妙。

source: It is strange, how these matters bear forth.
target: 这些事竟会这样发展，真是奇怪。

source: You are a source of myriad surprises. I would never have anticipated this.
target: 你总能带来种种意外。这件事，我绝不会预料到。

source: You are a source of myriad surprises. I would never have anticipated this.
target: 你总能带来无数意外。我绝想不到会有这样的结果。

source: It is not my place to pass judgement on this union. Nor is it Gertrude's, in the end.
target: 我无权评判这段结合。说到底，乔特鲁德也无权评判。

target: 毕竟，这已经不再是我们的世界。

target: 它属于活着的人。属于你。

source: If you leave Elsinore, then the whole, wide world awaits you. You could go anywhere. See anything.
target: 如果你离开埃尔西诺，整个辽阔的世界都在等着你。你可以去任何地方。见识任何事物。

source: You have a room full of people here who all thought they loved you, of course.
target: 当然，这一屋子的人都曾以为自己爱你。

source: But I'm only realizing this now. To us, love is owning something, breaking it, crushing it as you hold it too tightly.
target: 但我直到现在才明白。对我们来说，爱就是占有，就是把它弄坏，因为抓得太紧而将它捏碎。

source: Think carefully upon this, Ophelia.
target: 仔细想想这件事，奥菲莉娅。

source: Think carefully upon this, Ophelia.
target: 仔细想一想，奥菲莉娅。

source: You can never turn back.
target: 你再也无法回头。

source: You can never turn back.
target: 你永远都无法回头。

source: If you'll allow me, I shall set the scene.
target: 容我先交代一下眼下的情形。

source: When we last left Ophelia, she was ready to use the Book of Fates to leave Elsinore with myself and Guildenstern, abandoning everyone to their respective fates.
target: 上回说到奥菲莉娅时，她正准备使用《命运之书》，和我、吉尔登斯吞一起离开埃尔西诺，抛下所有人，让他们各自面对自己的命运。

source: I must admit, I'm a tad biased towards this proposal.
target: 我得承认，我对这个提议有那么一点偏心。

source: Me, too! We'll have so much fun, Ophelia. It really is a massive world out there, you know!
target: 我也是！我们会玩得很开心的，奥菲莉娅。你知道吗，外面的世界真的大得很！

source: And after a while, you just cease caring about anything you leave behind. It's simple! Just crunch it all down into a little ball of nothingness!
target: 而且过一阵子，你就不会再在乎留下的任何东西了。很简单！把它们全都压成一小团虚无就行！

source: Nary so much as a 'goodbye' wave. That's how we like to travel.
target: 连挥手道别都省了。我们就喜欢这样出发。

source: Hm. I must say, this is an option I myself have pursued a few times.
target: 嗯。我得说，我自己也做过几次这样的选择。

source: So that's it? You're off to go enjoy yourself across Europe as the rest of us die here?
target: 就这样？你要去欧洲各地逍遥快活，留我们其他人死在这里？

source: I thought you a stronger woman than that, Ophelia. I would never in all my life abandon you.
target: 奥菲莉娅，我以为你是个更坚强的女人。我这辈子都不会抛下你。

source: He's right, Ophelia. Certainly none of us are perfect. It could be argued that few of us are good. But I am... afraid to die.
target: 他说得对，奥菲莉娅。我们当然都不完美。或许可以说，我们中没几个算得上好人。但我……害怕死亡。

source: Please. I've always loved you like my own daughter. Don't abandon me now. You have a responsibility to us, just as we did to you.
target: 求你了。我一直像爱亲生女儿一样爱你。别在这时候抛下我。你对我们有责任，就像我们曾对你有责任一样。

source: Yes. Responsibility. That's the word.
target: 对。责任。就是这个词。

source: Irresponsible? That's what you think this choice is? I never asked to be here!
target: 不负责任？你们觉得这个选择就是不负责任？我从没要求来这里！

source: Is it so selfish of me to seek out some happiness in this miserable situation?
target: 身处这样悲惨的境地，我想找一点幸福，就有那么自私吗？

source: You went to Paris for that same reason, didn't you? To escape Elsinore. To be free.
target: 你去巴黎，不也是为了这个吗？为了逃离埃尔西诺。为了自由。

source: My sweet.
target: 我的宝贝。

source: I told your brother this once, a long time ago.
target: 很久以前，我曾对你哥哥说过这句话。

source: To thine own self be true.
target: 忠于你自己。

source: It's true now more than ever. Even if—
target: 现在比以往任何时候都更是如此。即使——

source: It's true now more than ever. Even if--
target: 如今这句话比以往任何时候都更有道理。即使——

source: Even if it means I'll never see my beloved daughter again.
target: 即使这意味着我再也见不到心爱的女儿。

source: If you think this is the fate you desire, then I am powerless to tell you otherwise.
target: 如果你认为这就是你想要的命运，那我也无力劝你改变心意。

source: Just know that I have always loved you with everything in my heart, and I would gladly die if it brought you eternal happiness.
target: 你只要知道，我一直全心全意地爱着你。只要能换来你永远的幸福，我就甘愿赴死。

source: I suppose Father's right.
target: 我想父亲说得对。

source: I did try to leave for Paris to make a new life for myself.
target: 我确实试过离开这里，去巴黎开始自己的新生活。

source: And perhaps, if I had succeeded, none of these horrible worlds would have come to pass.
target: 而且，如果我当时成功了，也许这些可怕的世界就都不会出现。

source: Go, Ophelia.
target: 走吧，奥菲莉娅。

source: You were the only thing worth living for.
target: 你曾是我活下去的唯一理由。

source: If you leave Elsinore, then the rest of us might as well perish, in my humble opinion.
target: 如果你离开埃尔西诺，依我拙见，我们剩下的人也不如死了算了。

source: I— think I could make something good and useful of myself, had I lived. But I'll never know for sure.
target: 我——觉得如果我还活着，也许能成为一个善良、有用的人。可我永远没法知道了。

source: I--  think I could make something good and useful of myself, had I lived. But I'll never know for sure.
target: 我——觉得，如果我活下来了，我也许能成为一个善良、有用的人。但我永远没法确定了。

source: And that is not an obligation you bear me: to trade your own destiny for mine.
target: 而你并没有义务为我这么做：拿你自己的命运来换我的。

source: So, go. Go, and live.
target: 所以，走吧。走吧，活下去。

source: Pfft. You're all taking this so seriously.
target: 嘁。你们也太当真了。

source: I admit, it rather takes me by surprise, Guilda.
target: 我承认，这还真让我挺意外的，吉尔达。

source: No wonder you're all shanking each other and soliloquizing all over the place!
target: 难怪你们一个个互相捅刀子，还走到哪儿都要来一段独白！

source: Let's begone from this place. All three of us.
target: 我们离开这地方吧。我们三个一起。

source: Ophelia, let me give you a little advice, Guildenstern Special Style:
target: 奥菲莉娅，让我给你一点吉尔登斯吞式的独家忠告：

source: You aren't responsible for the horrible things anyone does to anyone else.
target: 别人对彼此做出的那些可怕的事，不是你的责任。

source: So stop thinking about it, and just enjoy yourself!
target: 所以别再想这些了，好好享受吧！

source: Truly, that's all that matters in this world.
target: 说真的，这就是世上唯一要紧的事。

source: That, and understanding exactly how many sweetrolls you can eat before you puke.
target: 还有，要弄清楚你究竟能吃多少个甜面包卷才会吐。

source: Thirteen. Thirteen is that number.
target: 十三个。答案就是十三个。

source: Let's see if we can reach fourteen tonight!
target: 看看我们今晚能不能吃到十四个！

source: Agreed. Shall we go?
target: 好。我们走吧？

source: Think carefully upon this, Ophelia.
target: 仔细想想这件事，奥菲莉娅。

target: 当然，我没什么意见。我一直最盼望的就是离开这座城堡。

source: But if we leave court... Father must relinquish his advisory role to the throne.
target: 但如果我们离开宫廷……父亲就必须辞去王室顾问的职务。

source: That role means everything to him.
target: 那个职位就是他的一切。

source: It did, once.
target: 曾经是。

source: But these last few days have given me unnatural pause.
target: 但这几天让我产生了异乎寻常的犹疑。

source: After all, in other worlds, Hamlet kills me, and... no one grieves my loss.
target: 毕竟，在其他世界里，哈姆雷特杀了我，而……没有人为我的死感到悲伤。

source: If that's the measure of my use to the King and Queen, then what must I do to make them rethink their feelings towards me?
target: 如果这就是我在国王和王后眼中的价值，那我到底要怎么做，才能让他们重新看待我？

source: You gave me no reason to trust you, Polonius!
target: 你从没给过我信任你的理由，波洛涅斯！

source: You were never secretive about your undying faith to my brother.
target: 你从来不掩饰自己对我兄长至死不渝的忠诚。

source: Always hiding things from me, going behind my back to stir up trouble...
target: 总是对我隐瞒事情，背着我挑起事端……

source: Because I swore an oath to him in life!
target: 因为我在他生前就向他立过誓！

source: To you, my lord!
target: 向您立过誓，陛下！

source: I will always honor your memory, my King.
target: 我会永远怀着敬意缅怀您，我的国王。

source: But it is time for my children and me to move on.
target: 但我和孩子们也该继续自己的人生了。

source: I could never hold such a thing against you, Polonius.
target: 我绝不会因为这种事责怪你，波洛涅斯。

source: I could never hold such a thing against you, Polonius.
target: 我绝不会因此怪你，波洛涅斯。

source: After all, you let even your own lands and estates go fallow in your mission to uphold the throne.
target: 毕竟，为了维护王位，你甚至让自己的土地和庄园都荒废了。

source: After all, you let even your own lands and estates go fallow in your mission to uphold the throne.
target: 毕竟，为了维护王位，你甚至任由自己的土地和庄园荒废。

source: It's true. Our family has nothing, for all our titles. We are quite penniless, I'm afraid.
target: 确实如此。我们家虽有这些头衔，却一无所有。恐怕已经身无分文了。

source: Had I been more actively managing our estates, we might have found more success.
target: 如果我当初更用心经营庄园，我们或许会过得更好。

source: But years of idleness on that front—all in the interest of better dedicating myself to His Majesty—have run our coffers dry.
target: 可我多年没有打理那些产业——全是为了更好地效忠陛下——如今家中的钱财已经耗尽了。

source: But years of idleness on that front--all in the interest of better dedicating myself to His Majesty--have run our coffers dry.
target: 但我为了更好地效忠陛下，多年来疏于经营——如今家里的钱已经耗尽了。

source: Then where shall we live, Father?
target: 那我们要住在哪里，父亲？

source: In the last remaining estate we have. A small and forgotten place. It is far from the luxury of Elsinore Castle.
target: 住在我们仅剩的那座庄园里。那地方很小，也被人遗忘了。远比不上埃尔西诺城堡的奢华。

source: That's unfortunate to hear. But it is clear we cannot stay here.
target: 听到这消息真遗憾。但显然，我们不能留在这里。

source: If this is the world Ophelia chooses, then we must go to that forgotten place and see if we can't turn our fortunes around.
target: 如果这就是奥菲莉娅选择的世界，那我们就得去那个被遗忘的地方，看看能不能让家里的境况好转。

source: I find the notion unlikely. I fear this may be the very last of our noble house.
target: 我觉得希望不大。恐怕我们这个贵族家族就要走到尽头了。

source: That's what this world would mean.
target: 这个世界会意味着这样的结局。

source: I see. Then, sister, I hope you make the right choice.
target: 我明白了。那么，妹妹，希望你能做出正确的选择。

source: If you'll allow me, I shall set the scene.
target: 容我先交代一下眼下的情形。

source: When we last left Ophelia, she was ready to use the Book of Fates to remain in a perfect place forever.
target: 上回说到奥菲莉娅时，她正准备使用《命运之书》，永远留在一个完美的地方。

source: What say you about this, friends?
target: 朋友们，你们对此有什么看法？

source: There's my girl.
target: 我的好女儿来了。

source: We're all ready for you.
target: 我们都准备好迎接你了。

source: Ophelia! We were just saying your name. Speak of the devil!
target: 奥菲莉娅！我们刚刚还在说你呢。说谁谁就到！

source: What's going on here, everyone?
target: 大家，这里是怎么回事？

source: Well, we were waiting for you to tell us that.
target: 嗯，我们正等着你来告诉我们呢。

source: Yes, Lady Ophelia. You're the storyteller of this world. Anything you imagine, we can do.
target: 是的，奥菲莉娅女士。你是这个世界的故事讲述者。你想象得到的事，我们都能做到。

source: If you wanted to write me a larger part, I wouldn't be opposed to that...
target: 如果你想给我多写点戏份，我也不会反对……

source: Or if you wanted to cut Hamlet out of the narrative altogether. That's an option, too.
target: 或者你想把哈姆雷特从故事里彻底删掉，也可以。

source: Goodness.
target: 天哪。

source: Lads! Stop that talk, immediately. This is about Ophelia's desires. Not yours.
target: 小伙子们！立刻住口。这里要考虑的是奥菲莉娅的愿望，不是你们的。

source: You're right, Father.
target: 您说得对，父亲。

source: Ophelia, I apologize. Merely command us and we will do your bidding.
target: 奥菲莉娅，对不起。你只管下令，我们会照你的吩咐做。

source: And if you don't like the result—merely tell us to act differently, again and again.
target: 如果你不喜欢结果——只要叫我们换一种做法就行，一遍又一遍。

source: We'll be here forever. And we'll never leave, or be harmed by anything, or pass away.
target: 我们会永远留在这里。永不离开，不受任何伤害，也不会死去。

source: Unless that's your desire, of course.
target: 当然，除非你希望如此。

source: In which case, we'd be happy to oblige.
target: 那样的话，我们也很乐意照办。

source: You could even create a world where I was nice to you. Just think about that for a moment!
target: 你甚至可以创造一个我会对你友善的世界。好好想想吧！

source: It's insane, isn't it?
target: 真是疯了，对吧？

source: Insane...
target: 疯了……

source: Insane...
target: 疯了……

source: Ophelia. Cease this.
target: 奥菲莉娅。停下吧。

source: Ophelia. Cease this.
target: 奥菲莉娅。停下。

source: You cannot stay in this world.
target: 你不能留在这个世界。

source: You cannot stay in this world.
target: 你不能留在这个世界里。

source: It has lingered long past its due.
target: 它早就该消失，却一直留存至今。

source: It has lingered long past its due.
target: 它早就该结束了，却拖延至今。

source: How can you be certain of that?
target: 你怎么能确定？

source: Look at this. Look at how happy they all are.
target: 你看看。看看他们都多么开心。

source: This version of Elsinore... is merely a fantasy.
target: 这样的埃尔西诺……不过是个幻想。

source: This version of Elsinore... is merely a fantasy.
target: 这样的埃尔西诺……不过是个幻想。

source: It is a trick invented by your own mind.
target: 这是你自己的头脑编造出来的骗局。

source: It is a trick invented by your own mind.
target: 这是你自己的头脑编造出来的骗局。

source: This version of events may never come to pass. This is the reality of this world when all illusion is wiped away. You are alone.
target: 这样的事态也许永远不会发生。当所有幻象都被抹去，这个世界的真相就是如此。你孤身一人。

source: This version of events may never come to pass. This is the reality of this world when all illusion is wiped away. You are alone.
target: 这样的事情也许永远不会发生。当一切幻象被抹去，这才是这个世界的真实面貌。你只有自己一个人。

source: In life, I did not fight Insanity. I relinquished myself to her. I was subjugated, consumed, and finally death took me.
target: 生前，我没有与疯狂抗争。我把自己交给了她。我被她征服、吞噬，最终死亡带走了我。

source: In life, I did not fight Insanity. I relinquished myself to her. I was subjugated, consumed, and finally death took me.
target: 生前，我没有与疯狂抗争。我把自己交给了她。我被她征服、吞噬，最终被死亡带走。

source: Think carefully on whether you wish to do the same.
target: 仔细想想，你是否也想这么做。

target: 仔细想想，你是否也想这么做。

target: 在你受妄想控制的时候，所有还活着的人都会迎来惨烈的命运。无论做多少梦，都无法救他们逃过这一劫。

source: While you lie in the grip of your delusion, everyone still alive will meet a grisly fate. No amount of dreaming can save them from that.
target: 当你困在妄想之中时，所有还活着的人都会遭遇惨烈的命运。做再多的梦也救不了他们。

source: If I choose this ending... I have to accept... that it can never be real.
target: 如果我选择这个结局……我就必须接受……它永远不可能是真的。

source: But it felt real. It still can.
target: 可它感觉那么真实。它仍然可以给我这种感觉。

source: If you'll allow me, I shall set the scene.
target: 容我先交代一下眼下的情形。

source: When we last left Ophelia, she was ready to use the Book of Fates to hold off Fortinbras' invasion and save everyone's lives.
target: 上次说到奥菲莉娅时，她正准备利用《命运之书》阻止福丁布拉斯的入侵，救下所有人的性命。

source: S-so she did it! She's saved us all from a tragic fate!
target: 那、那她成功了！她让我们所有人都逃过了悲惨的命运！

source: Ah... so it would seem.
target: 啊……看来是这样。

source: I for one am thrilled to not be the only one left alive.
target: 至少我高兴极了，总算不是只有我一个人活下来了。

source: As much as you're all a group of rather moody, melodramatic fools, you've become my melodramatic fools.
target: 虽然你们都是一群情绪多变、爱小题大做的傻瓜，但如今，你们已经是我的那群傻瓜了。

source: I did not think I would live long enough to spend all the money I made fleecing the guards out of their pay.
target: 我本以为自己活不到把从卫兵那里骗来的军饷全花光的那一天。

source: What a relief it is to be proven wrong.
target: 发现自己想错了，真让人松了一口气。

source: And I'm sure you'll steal a lot more of their pay before you go to your grave kicking, old woman.
target: 我相信，在你不甘不愿地咽气之前，你还会偷走他们更多的军饷，老太婆。

source: Yes, or until they grow wiser about my loaded dice. I'm sure I'll die before that happens. Idiots.
target: 没错，除非他们长点脑子，看出我的骰子做了手脚。不过我肯定等不到那天就死了。一群蠢货。

source: At one point, I wanted nothing more than to die.
target: 曾有一段时间，我一心只想死。

source: Now the gift of life is thrust upon us.
target: 如今，生命这份礼物却被硬塞给了我们。

source: Even those of us who didn't deserve to live are here.
target: 就连我们当中那些不配活着的人，也还在这里。

source: Stop that, Hamlet.
target: 别这样说，哈姆雷特。

source: It's true you and your uncle have been at odds lately. However...
target: 你和你叔叔最近确实不和。不过……

source: Now that the war is won, there is time for peace to come to us all, in our own ways, in our own time!
target: 如今战争已经打赢了，我们都有时间按自己的方式、自己的步调，找到各自的安宁！

source: Yes, we ought to celebrate this gift of peace we've all been given!
target: 是啊，我们应该庆祝这份赐予我们所有人的和平！

source: Your Highness... the war is not won.
target: 殿下……这场战争还没打赢。

source: Did you think the war was over?
target: 您以为战争已经结束了吗？

source: It... it isn't?
target: 还……还没有？

source: No. Of course it isn't.
target: 没有。当然没有。

source: Fortinbras may have been stopped for now, but he is relentless, and his men are brutally faithful to him.
target: 福丁布拉斯眼下或许被挡住了，但他不会善罢甘休，他的手下也对他死心塌地，凶残至极。

source: They will come for him. And when he is free, they will come for our country.
target: 他们会来救他。等他重获自由，他们就会来夺取我们的国家。

source: But we are well prepared. I've rallied good men to my side. Useful men.
target: 但我们已经做好了充分的准备。我已经召集了一批优秀的人到我身边。都是能派上用场的人。

source: Let us give them a fight worth fighting!
target: 就让我们和他们痛痛快快地打一场！

source: This won't be a fight. It'll be a slow massacre.
target: 这不会是一场交战，而是一场缓慢的屠杀。

source: Only a war of attrition lies ahead.
target: 前方等着我们的，只有一场消耗战。

source: What she speaks is truth, my lord. Fortinbras will not relent. And neither shall we.
target: 陛下，她说的是真的。福丁布拉斯不会退让，我们也不会。

source: The men we have rallied are sufficient, but not a force worth marveling at. I predict weary years ahead.
target: 我们召集的兵力够用，却远称不上强大。我预计，往后多年都会疲于征战。

source: We averted a coup. We have not won a war.
target: 我们阻止了一场政变，却没有赢得一场战争。

source: Then we shall all bear witness to whatever mysteries the future brings.
target: 那么，无论未来带来怎样的未知，我们都将一同见证。

source: I suppose we cannot truly know. Not yet.
target: 我想，我们确实无从知道。至少现在还不知道。

source: That is the summary of it, yes.
target: 是的，大致就是这样。

source: That is the summary of it, yes.
target: 是的，大致就是如此。

source: Consider your options carefully, Ophelia.
target: 仔细考虑你的选择，奥菲莉娅。

source: Consider your options carefully, Ophelia.
target: 仔细考虑你有哪些选择，奥菲莉娅。

source: Life in place of death is not always a gift. You and I know that truest of all.
target: 以生代死，并不总是恩赐。你我比任何人都明白这一点。

target: 以生代死，并不总是一份恩赐。你我比谁都清楚这一点。

target: 上次说到奥菲莉娅时，她正准备利用《命运之书》嫁给哈姆雷特王子，成为丹麦王后。

source: What say you all about this?
target: 大家对此有什么看法？

source: Excellent. Good riddance to both of you.
target: 太好了。总算摆脱你们两个了。

source: And a special thanks to you, Ophelia. You've saved me from a life of having to be near Hamlet.
target: 尤其要谢谢你，奥菲莉娅。多亏了你，我不用一辈子待在哈姆雷特身边了。

source: Evidently my mood of late was more offensive to all of you than I thought.
target: 看来我最近的坏情绪，比我想的还要让大家讨厌。

source: Happens to the best of us, Hamlet. But it seems as though this betrothal has turned your state around.
target: 再好的人也有这种时候，哈姆雷特。不过，看来这次订婚让你的状态好转了。

source: Much as I hate to admit it, I've never seen you happier.
target: 虽然不愿承认，但我从没见过你这么开心。

source: I suppose... it's changed me.
target: 我想……这确实改变了我。

source: Everyone, I must apologize for my mood as of late.
target: 各位，我必须为最近的坏情绪向大家道歉。

source: It's been the darkest year of my life. There were moments when I prayed for death more fervently than I've ever wanted anything.
target: 这是我一生中最黑暗的一年。有些时候，我祈求死亡的心，比我对任何事物的渴望都要强烈。

source: But... Ophelia showed me a world where it was possible to reclaim who I was before.
target: 但是……奥菲莉娅让我看到了一个世界，在那里，我还有可能找回从前的自己。

source: The old me wasn't gone. He was merely buried under the weight of paralyzing fear.
target: 从前的我并没有消失。他只是被令人动弹不得的恐惧压在了深处。

source: And I'm no longer afraid.
target: 而如今，我不再害怕了。

source: Especially with you by my side.
target: 尤其是有你在我身边。

source: This was the union I always desired.
target: 我一直盼望的就是这桩婚事。

source: I merely wish it had happened sooner. But...
target: 我只希望这一天能来得更早些。不过……

source: Well, circumstances were different then.
target: 唉，当时的情况不同。

source: I am, and shall always be, opposed to this union.
target: 我反对这桩婚事，而且永远都会反对。

source: We know Polonius's estate is dry. No dowry to her name, no social ties, no status... it weakens Denmark.
target: 我们都知道，波洛涅斯的家产已经空了。她没有嫁妆，没有人脉，没有地位……这会削弱丹麦。

source: A King ought to marry strategically. Not on his own blind whim!
target: 国王的婚姻应当讲究策略，不能凭自己一时的盲目冲动！

source: Hush, brother.
target: 安静些，弟弟。

source: And then there's Father and I. He exiled us, Ophelia.
target: 还有父亲和我呢。他把我们流放了，奥菲莉娅。

source: He'd kill us if he could.
target: 如果可以，他会杀了我们。

source: Try as you might, you won't change his heart on this front. He knows I'm a danger to him. And he's right. I'll never serve him as my King.
target: 无论你怎么努力，都改变不了他在这件事上的心意。他知道我对他是个威胁。而他是对的。我永远不会奉他为王，向他效忠。

source: You will grow old without either of us in your life.
target: 你会慢慢老去，而你的生活里再也没有我们两个人。

source: Do Father and I mean so little to you that you're willing to throw us away?
target: 父亲和我对你就这么不重要，让你甘愿抛弃我们吗？

source: If you'll allow me, I shall set the scene.
target: 容我先交代一下眼下的情形。

source: When we last left Ophelia, she was ready to use the Book of Fates to allow Norway to rule through Hamlet, bringing the two countries into a partnership of sorts.
target: 上次说到奥菲莉娅时，她正准备利用《命运之书》让挪威通过哈姆雷特进行统治，使两国形成某种合作关系。

source: What say you all about this?
target: 大家对此有什么看法？

source: Is this not the world any decent person would seek? A world where all survive?
target: 这不正是任何一个正直的人都会追求的世界吗？一个所有人都能活下来的世界？

source: One where Hamlet is free to take his father's throne, and forced by virtue of another ruler to act, rather than remain paralyzed?
target: 在这个世界里，哈姆雷特能够继承父亲的王位，又因另一位统治者的存在而被迫行动，不再困在原地、动弹不得？

source: Certainly I think so.
target: 我当然这么认为。

source: W-well, what about me? Where is my life in all this?
target: 那、那我呢？我的命又算什么？

source: Ophelia, have you deemed me beyond redemption? Am I not included in your salvation?
target: 奥菲莉娅，你已经认定我无可救赎了吗？你要拯救的人里，没有我吗？

source: Feh! Should've considered that before you offed a perfectly good king!
target: 呸！你杀掉一位好端端的国王之前，就该想想这事！

source: Look at the mess you made of it all!
target: 瞧瞧你把这一切弄成了什么样！

source: The mess I've made? What of Denmark? What of our nation?
target: 我弄成的烂摊子？那丹麦呢？我们的国家呢？

source: We're scarcely our own people now. Merely a pale shadow of Norway's ambitions.
target: 如今，我们几乎已经失去了自主，只是挪威野心投下的一道黯淡影子。

source: And what shall become of Denmark in a dozen years, or in a hundred? Shall we even exist?
target: 十几年后，或是一百年后，丹麦又会变成什么样？我们还会存在吗？

source: All of our stories, all of our selves forgotten!
target: 我们所有的故事，我们所有人的自我，都会被遗忘！

source: Have all of you forgotten Ogier, that knight of Charlemagne? Legend says his spirit dwells within this very castle.
target: 你们都忘了奥吉尔，查理曼的那位骑士吗？传说他的灵魂就栖居在这座城堡里。

source: And when Denmark is most at peril, he shall rise and take arms to defend us all. Have you forgotten what others sacrificed?
target: 当丹麦面临最大的危难时，他会起身拿起武器，保卫我们所有人。你们忘了别人付出过怎样的牺牲吗？

source: It is the King of Denmark's calling to fight on her behalf. What kind of coward merely hands her over to her enemies?
target: 为丹麦而战，是丹麦国王的使命。怎样的懦夫，才会就这么把她交到敌人手里？

source: Is that true, Hamlet?

source: Indeed. You always knew my heart best, Gerta.
target: 的确。你一直最懂我的心，格尔塔。

source: I wish my son were strong enough to stand and fight.
target: 我希望我的儿子能足够坚强，挺身而出，奋起抗争。

source: I wish my son were strong enough to stand and fight.
target: 我多希望我的儿子足够坚强，能够挺身而战。

source: As do I, Father.
target: 我也这么希望，父亲。

source: I fear I shall think of that every morning until you and I can discuss it at length in Heaven one day.
target: 恐怕今后的每个清晨，我都会想起这件事，直到有一天，你我能在天堂里好好谈一谈。

source: We mustn't be too hard on Hamlet.
target: 我们不能对哈姆雷特太苛刻。

source: A war with Fortinbras would have cost more than any of us know.
target: 如果与福丁布拉斯开战，代价会比我们任何人所知的都要大。

source: I cannot say whether we would have won. But the destruction would have been... extensive.
target: 我说不准我们能不能赢。但造成的破坏一定会……极其惨重。

source: Many would have died to keep Denmark as Denmark.
target: 许多人会为了让丹麦仍是丹麦而死。

source: Ophelia, you're trading away a nation to keep people alive.
target: 奥菲莉娅，你是用一个国家，换取人们的生存。

source: My father would not have made that trade. Claudius would not. Neither would King Hamlet.
target: 我父亲不会做这样的交换。克劳狄斯不会，哈姆雷特国王也不会。

source: ...Nor, truthfully, can I claim that I would, either.
target: ……说实话，我也不能说我会这么做。

source: But you aren't like any of us. That's why you were able to keep all of us alive.
target: 但你和我们任何人都不同。正因如此，你才能让我们所有人活下来。

source: Just be careful. Be careful what you're willing to give up. Know that it cannot be recovered.
target: 只是，一定要慎重。想清楚你愿意放弃什么。要知道，失去了就再也拿不回来了。
